task_specification.objective: Restore audible, exactly-once automatic-combat feedback while delivering a stable dense-wave profile and a complete ordinary run/retry release path with spatially coherent arena presentation and truthful, accessible upgrade choices.

diagnosis.root_cause: The authoritative Warden Lantern attack and impact transactions complete, but the product-owned audio integration produces no Effects-bus output. Prior attempts did not establish a direct event-to-bus and envelope isolation, so the remaining defect is most plausibly adapter ownership, routing, or impact-cue masking rather than combat causality.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically modify the preserved authored cemetery package or retained component weapon/audio source.
Stop after the three bounded task families have closure-ready implementation and the specified same-session recapture can retest them.
Do not treat telemetry-only evidence, synthetic setup, or a failure route as proof of a successful end-of-run build shape.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy for the repeatedly unresolved audio issue: isolate authoritative event ownership, Effects-bus routing, and transient envelopes with bounded positive-control stems, while independently hardening dense lifecycle cost and the ordinary spatial/HUD release contract.

code: Run existing project checks and targeted static/source validation for audio ownership/routing, dense lifecycle guards, collision/spawn contracts, lifecycle reset, upgrade eligibility, and release-build tester-action guards.
Verify preserved authored map children and retained component weapon/audio assets remain intact and unmodified.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester recaptures SEMI, quick AUTO tap, release/reset, and legal-hit audio with Effects waveform and source-event timelines.
Recapture representative dense-wave runtime state with frame-time distribution, live/pooled counts, workload counters, and repeated Retry baseline checks.

Recapture ordinary successful traversal at spawn, critical route, central building/landmark, and boundary/perimeter, plus countdown zero, death/result, Retry, and fresh-run states; verify collision, external depth, visibility, no disappearance/occlusion drift, and build identity.
Recapture upgrade/weapon choice states at configured viewport with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus and truthful current-to-new deltas.
visual: Inspect preserved cemetery composition and camera framing from normal gameplay, landmark/cardinal, route, and perimeter views for coherent external world depth, stable collision-aligned geometry, and no placeholder content.
Inspect choice cards for silhouettes, compact icons, concise hierarchy, truthful deltas, omitted unchanged fields, and distinct focus/hover/pressed/disabled states.
Inspect audio evidence for one bounded firearm transient per SEMI/AUTO action and an audible lantern onset/impact without a masking long material ring.

done_when: One SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap each produce exactly one short, recognizable firearm transient in mixed output, with onset, legal-hit impact, miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, character-hit, and enemy-spatial stems separately identifiable in the source timeline.

Automatic lantern onset and legal-hit impact are non-silent on Effects at gameplay gain, with no long ringing material cue masking the firearm report; sustained AUTO starts only after cadence-valid continuation and stops on release and lifecycle reset.
The retained component gun audio, source assets, hierarchy, active profile, transforms, offsets, and recoil timings remain unchanged; generic shot VFX does not replay the complete player recording.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned automatic-combat audio adapter and material-impact routing. Trace the authoritative attack transaction through the weapon controller and combat feedback presenter into the Effects owner; add bounded onset/impact envelopes and deduplication, and isolate player firearm, miss, concrete/metal/character impact, and enemy spatial stems. If no short surface cue is reliable, disable player world-surface impact audio while retaining compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback. Preserve the retained component gun path and all bound weapon data. Make SEMI, quick AUTO tap/release, and lifecycle reset directly reproducible for same-session retest.
tasks.title: Restore automatic-combat audio causality

done_when: A representative 25–40-enemy final-wave scenario maintains bounded frame-time distribution without runaway allocations, duplicate attack loops, recurring runtime errors, or unbounded audio/VFX workload.

Spawn, steering, targeting, projectile, pickup, particle, light, and physics-query work is bounded or staggered where profiling proves it necessary, while attack causality, telegraphs, legal targets, and pool reset correctness remain intact.

Instrumentation exposes frame time, active and pooled entity counts, and relevant workload counters in a release-safe way without changing shipped behavior; repeated Retry cycles return counts, timers, listeners, pause state, and audio to baseline.
tasks.instructions: Profile the real-density final-wave path and fix measured frame-time spikes or object churn in director spawning, enemy neighbor/steering updates, targeting, projectiles, pickups, VFX, dynamic lights, and audio voices. Prefer bounded registries, staggered updates, or pooling only where evidence supports them. Verify deterministic spawn safety and reset every pooled enemy/projectile/pickup/impact state across repeated Retry. Keep diagnostics disabled or guarded for release exports.
tasks.title: Stabilize dense-wave performance

done_when: An ordinary successful route starts at a valid spawn and traverses a larger traversable scale through a coherent external world, reaches the central building/landmark, and preserves visibility without disappearance or occlusion drift during ordinary movement/movement replay.

Visible geometry and collision agree at the boundary/perimeter and along the route: movement cannot pass through important structures, props do not create invisible barriers, and landmark/external depth remains stable from spawn, critical route, and cardinal views.

Countdown zero, ordinary death, Result, Retry, and fresh-run reset work exactly once with no stale enemies, pooled entities, upgrades, audio loops, pause reasons, or HUD state; successful completion preserves distinct build identity and truthful upgrade effects.

Upgrade and weapon choices lead with authored silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, and no more than three truthful current-to-new stat deltas; CURRENT never uses NEW or LOCKED placeholders, unchanged rows are omitted, and keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed/disabled states are complete.
tasks.instructions: Harden the ordinary release route around the intact authored cemetery map. Rebase spawn, objective, navigation, and collision checks onto native streets/terrain; expand to a larger traversable scale by exposing the existing authored space, maintaining external world depth and stable central building/landmark visibility. Validate collision and boundary/perimeter behavior under ordinary movement/movement replay, explicitly checking disappearance and camera occlusion. Complete countdown/death/result/retry lifecycle disposal and build identity. Rework the choice presentation into the required authored visual hierarchy and all input focus states without changing the preserved world package. Any tester-only setup must be isolated, receipt-bound, and unavailable in release exports.
tasks.title: Complete ordinary release route, spatial integrity, and HUD choices
